title: Pricing questions
q1: Can I start free and upgrade later?
a1: Yes. The Free plan is unlimited for basic writing. When you need more characters, branches, or AI, upgrade to the plan you need. No surprises.
a2: Tokens are the unit of measurement for AI calls. A short message uses ~500 tokens. A long message with story context can use ~2000 tokens.
q3: Does the AI write my story?
a3: No. The AI is a companion that suggests, detects inconsistencies, and talks to your characters. It never writes the story for you.
q4: What happens if I exceed my tokens?
a4: You can buy extra tokens at $2 per 50K tokens. Or wait until next month for your pool to renew.
a5: Yes. No commitment. Cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of the paid period.
q6: Does the Free plan have a time limit?
a6: No. The Free plan is forever. It only has limits on advanced features, not on usage time.
